input.job_text: We are hiring a Backend Engineer to build payment APIs. Must have strong Python and PostgreSQL experience. Experience with Docker is a plus. Responsibilities: design REST services, write tests, review code. Keywords: Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, REST.

Data Analyst role for the growth team. Requirements: SQL and Tableau. Excel is preferred. Responsibilities: build dashboards, maintain reporting pipelines, present weekly insights. Keywords: SQL, Tableau, Excel, dashboards.

Frontend developer for our design system team. Must have React and TypeScript. Nice to have Storybook experience. Responsibilities: build accessible components, partner with designers, improve testing. Keywords: React, TypeScript, Storybook, accessibility.
